name: semaphor
description: Build Semaphor-backed React data apps with governed analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Build React data apps with governed Semaphor analytics.
interface.longDescription: Adds workflows for inspecting Semaphor project data, planning React data apps, generating components with react-semaphor/data-app-sdk builders and useSemaphorQuery, running local and governed validation, and saving or publishing apps through Semaphor-hosted Data App lifecycle APIs.
defaultPrompt: Plan a data app from my data.
Add a KPI with top contributors.
